parameters.name: BackendServers
parameters.description: The list of backend servers to remove. You can remove up to 20 backend servers in each call.

sub_parameters.name: Ip
sub_parameters.description: The IP address of the backend server.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The port used by the backend of the load balancing instance.

sub_parameters.name: ServerId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the backend server.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The backend server type. Valid values:
- **ens**: ENS instance.
- **eni**: network interface controller (NIC) instance.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description: The weight of the backend server.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the load balancing instance.
